understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every goal by stepping onto each goal cell while the carried piece matches its required shape, color, and rotation. Completing all goals advances through the levels and ultimately wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life and resets stamina. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates when all three attributes match, then must be reached by movement to complete it.
